args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The case `Decimal("2.665") -> 2.66` failed under HALF_UP.

## Fix
- Switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.

transcript.reasoning_content: Wait: test expects 2.675 → 2.68. But with ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantize, 2.675 quantized to 0.01... Decimal("2.675") is exact, half-even rounds 2.675 to 2.68? Half-even: digit to round is 7 (hundredths), 2.675 → tie at 2.67 vs 2.68; even one is 2.68? 2.67 has last digit 7 (odd), 2.68 is 8 (even) → rounds to 2.68. And 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). So ROUND_HALF_EVEN passes. ROUND_HALF_UP would give 2.68 and 2.67 → fails. So fix: change to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
